description: Java class 'HttpRequestFileUpload' for handling file uploads via HttpServletRequest, including parsing multipart form data, saving files, and validating uploads.

classes.name: HttpRequestFileUpload
classes.description: Handles multipart file upload processing, including reading request data, saving files, and validating uploads.

methods.name: getOverrideFilename
methods.description: Returns the override filename if set.

methods.name: setOverrideFilename
methods.description: Sets a custom filename to override the uploaded filename.

methods.name: getFilepath
methods.description: Returns the full filepath of the uploaded file.

methods.name: setSavePath
methods.description: Sets the directory path where files will be saved.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the uploaded file.

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a form field.

methods.name: doUpload
methods.description: Processes the HttpServletRequest to handle file upload, save files, and validate.

methods.name: waitingReadLine
methods.description: Reads a line from ServletInputStream, waiting if necessary, with timeout.
